description: Submits a signed transaction to the cluster for processing.

parameters.name: transaction
parameters.description: The transaction as an encoded string.

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The configuration object with the following fields:

sub_parameters.name: skipPreflight
sub_parameters.description: (default: false) If true, skip the preflight transaction checks

sub_parameters.name: preflightCommitment
sub_parameters.description: (default: finalized) The commitment level to use for preflight

sub_parameters.name: encoding
sub_parameters.description: The encoding format for account data. It can be one of base58 (slow), base64, base64+zstd or jsonParsed

sub_parameters.name: maxRetries
sub_parameters.description: The maximum number of times for the RPC node to retry sending the transaction to the leader. If this parameter is not provided, the RPC node will retry the transaction until it is finalized or until the blockhash expires

sub_parameters.name: minContextSlot
sub_parameters.description: The minimum slot at which the request can be evaluated

result.description: The First Transaction Signature embedded in the transaction, as base-58 encoded string (transaction id)
